_: The `hooks` block of `bin/migrate-layout <clone at 4cdf70a> --tier all --json` (a dry run on a clone of church_growth after the sync and the hook replacement, before the move). The one site with runs_tool true is .githooks/pre-commit:303.

sites.text: # Refuses a commit that changes tracked content unless CHANGELOG.md is co-staged,
# repo (like this one) that has no root SESSION_RUNNER.md to run that gate.
#   Opt out:     delete CHANGELOG.md and record that decision in CLAUDE.md
LEGACY=CHANGELOG.md                 # layout: ok -- the selftest builds the legacy layout's fixtures
ROOTRUN=SESSION_RUNNER.md           # layout: ok -- the same framework anchor at the root, for the tie fixtures
OLDARCH=docs/archive                # layout: ok -- the legacy shard directory, for the trim fixtures
# hook found no tracked CHANGELOG.md and took its "no ledger, never block" branch. X2 is the first
# Quality ratchet (quality-ratchet plan, D2; SAFEGUARDS.md Blast Radius Limits): refuse a
# commit that LOOSENS a declared threshold in .quality-gates.json, or removes the manifest.
# guard on the worktree alone let `git rm .quality-gates.json` through untested (PR #82
mfile=.quality-gates.json   # layout: ok -- the manifest's name; both places are tried below
rtool=quality_ratchet.py    # layout: ok -- the tool's name; the three places are tried below
legacy_ledger=CHANGELOG.md                # layout: ok -- the legacy half of the table this hook resolves
legacy_runner=SESSION_RUNNER.md           # layout: ok -- the framework anchor, root half: it decides a tie (plan 7.2a)
legacy_archive=docs/archive               # layout: ok -- where a trim writes its shard today

paths.text: LEGACY=CHANGELOG.md                 # layout: ok -- the selftest builds the legacy layout's fixtures
